subcategory_text: Incident reports are triaged and validated
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: IR-04, IR-05, IR-06
ISO/IEC 27001:2022: Annex A.5.24, Annex A.5.26, Annex A.5.27, Annex A.5.28, Annex A.6.8
implementation_examples: Preliminarily review incident reports to confirm that they are cybersecurity-related and necessitate incident response activities
Apply criteria to estimate the severity of an incident
assessment_objectives: Determine whether incident reports are triaged and validated.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that preliminarily review incident reports to confirm that they are cybersecurity-related and necessitate incident response activities.
Determine whether activities are conducted to apply criteria to estimate the severity of an incident.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
